analysis.reasonEn: RSI entered oversold for 3 consecutive days. ADX at 31.7 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, showing downward pressure dominance. Volume ratio at 0.85 of the 5-day average suggests subdued activity, lowering confidence in trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
